design: Retrospective external evidence-routing audit; outcomes in abstracts and search previews were already known before this protocol. No blinded or independent coding and no prospective prediction accuracy is claimed.

frame.include: Both evaluated defenses, WTF-PAD and Walkie-Talkie
All three implementations, FRONT, Tamaraw, Random-WT; security and cost kept as separate outcomes within each row
All nine reevaluated defenses plus the distinct live DynaFlow execution record

units: 15 measurement records in 14 defense-study pairs from three follow-up studies; overlapping defenses and outcomes are not independent trials.
extraction: Record published mechanism/configuration, target setting, changed objects, source/follow-up locators, published outcome, and measurement required by R1-R9. Preserve successful/reduced-risk outcomes and negative or inconclusive results. Do not relabel Random-WT as original symmetric Walkie-Talkie.
comparators: Carry forward mechanism-name security and cost
Treat every changed boundary as a defense failure
Established WF evaluation practice (adaptive retraining, changed-view testing, and online cost measurement)
outputs: Complete evidence ledger with exclusion log
Counts by changed object and retained/measured outcomes, without pooling different accuracy denominators
Negative controls: do risk flags imply observed failure?
Baseline comparison of requested measurements, including ties to established WF practice
inference: Descriptive source-grounded decisions. No significance test or random-R-item hit-rate claim on outcome-informed labels; no new independent deployment samples. A framework routing a remeasurement does not predict failure.
C: Audit Git tree/time ordering and recompute current seven judgment statuses using R3 corrections; preserve original registration and outcome labels.
